Rank 28 - Service

Home Service Job Scheduler

Home service businesses need booking, technician assignment, job status, customer due, and service warranty.

Calculate revenue Open overview

Suggested package

BDT 10,000Installation/setup fee
BDT 700Recommended monthly charge

BDT 700/month works for teams with multiple jobs per day and several workers.

6.7Practical score based on daily pain, willingness to pay, support load, and expansion potential.
BDT 10,000Default setup used in calculator.
BDT 700Suggested monthly price after support-cost thinking.
BDT 9,200,000Gross year-one revenue at 1,000 businesses.

Why this can work

Target AC repair teams, cleaning teams, electricians, plumbers, shifting teams, and small service agencies.

Jobs are booked by phone, technicians forget timing, and owners do not know which job is paid.

Every job has technician, time, status, charge, and warranty.

Validation signals

  • Local-service platforms exist, proving demand.
  • Small teams need internal scheduling.
  • Warranty record reduces disputes.
  • Technician assignment is owner-visible.

MVP modules

  • Job booking
  • Technician assignment
  • Customer address
  • Status
  • Service charge
  • Warranty date
  • Daily job report

Do not build first

  • Do not build open marketplace first.
  • Do not add live GPS first.
  • Do not promise background checks.

Money model

Change the inputs and see the business case instantly.

Use support cost as a reality check. Low monthly pricing looks attractive until support eats the margin.

Risks and fixes

Risks
  • Technician adoption.
  • Address complexity.
  • Customer no-shows.
Mitigations
  • Owner/dispatcher entry first.
  • Map link field.
  • Reminder messages.
